sources.excerpt: Las Lunas by Vemuram | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE Vemuram Las Lunas LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS DISTORTION Description The Vemuram Las Lunas is an analog distortion pedal designed to recreate the drive tones favored by late 1970s and early 1980s guitar heroes. The circuit features a two-way toggle switch to alternate between a flatter, warmer drive voice and a sharper, more aggressive distortion voice, with dedicated internal trimmers for independent saturation adjustment. Tone shaping is managed by a three-band passive EQ with wide-ranging controls for bass, midrange tone, and upper-register treble. Hand-built in Japan using a custom brass enclosure, the pedal utilizes true bypass switching to maintain pure signal path integrity.
